title: Crop and resize a photo
summary: Trim a photo with the Crop tool, then change its pixel size with Image Size.

steps.say: Open a photo with Control O, or make sure one is already showing in the middle of the window.

check.prompt: Is a photo open and visible in the middle of the Photoshop window?

hints: Use File, then Open, and pick any JPG from your Pictures folder.
Dragging a photo file onto the Photoshop window opens it too.
steps.why: Every edit needs an open document to act on.

steps.say: Press C to pick the Crop tool.

checks.prompt: Is a crop box with corner handles now shown around the photo?

hints: The Crop tool is the square icon with overlapping corners in the toolbar on the left.
If another tool appears, press Shift C until the Crop tool is active.
steps.why: The Crop tool trims away the outer parts of an image.

steps.say: Drag a corner handle of the crop box inward to frame the part you want to keep.

check.prompt: Is the crop box smaller than the photo, with the area outside it darkened?

hints: Grab the small corner marks of the box, not the middle of the photo.
Choose a ratio such as 1 to 1 in the options bar if you want a square.
steps.why: Framing first lets you see exactly what stays before anything is removed.

steps.say: Press Enter to apply the crop.

checks.prompt: Has the photo been trimmed so the crop box and darkened border are gone?

hints: You can also click the check mark at the right end of the options bar.
Changed your mind? Control Z undoes the crop.
steps.why: A crop is only a preview until you confirm it.

steps.say: Press Control Alt I to open the Image Size dialog.

checks.prompt: Is the Image Size dialog open, showing Width and Height boxes?

hints: It is also in the Image menu at the top, called Image Size.
Click on the photo first if the shortcut does nothing, so Photoshop has focus.
steps.why: Image Size changes how many pixels the photo has.

steps.say: Make sure the unit says Pixels, type 1200 in the Width box, then click OK.

check.prompt: Is the Image Size dialog closed, and does the document look smaller or show a lower pixel size than before?

hints: Keep the link icon between Width and Height turned on so the photo does not stretch.
Leave Resample ticked; that is what changes the pixel count.
steps.why: A smaller pixel size makes the file lighter for email and the web.
